description: One coverage-aware supplier check combining company, qualified-invoice and address evidence. Use when: You need one coverage-aware supplier check combining company, qualified-invoice, and address evidence; optionally includes projected gBizINFO activity evidence when the internal feature flag is enabled. Returns: Independent evidence checks, source versions, and a resolved/ambiguous/not-found/insufficient-coverage status; optional gBizINFO is projected enrichment inside this response, not a standalone source or raw-response resale. Not a legal or KYB determination. Price: $0.10 USDC per successful call, paid with x402 on Base. / 会社・適格請求書・住所の根拠をまとめて仕入先を確認します。 用途: 会社、適格請求書、住所の根拠を組み合わせ、必要に応じて内部機能フラグでgBizINFO活動根拠も付加した、対象範囲を明示した仕入先確認を行う場合。 返却: 個別の根拠チェック、ソース版、resolved/ambiguous/not-found/insufficient-coverage状態を返します。任意のgBizINFOはこのレスポンス内の加工済み補助根拠であり、単独ソースや原レスポンスの再販ではありません。法的判断やKYB判定ではありません。 料金: 成功した呼び出し1回あたり $0.10 USDC（Base上のx402決済）。

inputSchema.description: Inputs for evidence composition; this endpoint makes no KYB conclusion.

address.description: Supplier address, used as supporting evidence. / 仕入先住所（補助根拠）。
address.title: Address

corporate_number.description: 13-digit Japanese corporate number (法人番号), digits only. / 13桁の法人番号（数字のみ）。
corporate_number.title: Corporate Number

country_code.description: Supplier country. Only JP is supported (GB was retired on 2026-11-08). / 仕入先の国。JPのみ対応（GBは2026-11-08に終了）。
country_code.title: Country Code

identifiers.description: Optional extra identifiers; allowed keys: corporate_number, registration_number, t_number, company_number, lei. / 追加識別子（任意）。使用可能なキー：corporate_number、registration_number、t_number、company_number、lei。
identifiers.title: Identifiers

name.description: Registered (Japanese) supplier name. English or romanized names are not in the registered-name index; resolve them first with POST /v1/jp/entities/resolve. / 登記上の仕入先名（日本語）。英語名・ローマ字名は登記名索引にありません。
name.title: Name

registration_number.description: Supplier qualified-invoice registration number (T + 13 digits). / 仕入先の適格請求書登録番号（T＋13桁）。
registration_number.title: Registration Number

response_language.description: Response presentation language: ja, en, or both. / レスポンス表示言語: ja（日本語）、en（英語）、both（両方）。
response_language.title: Response Language

t_number.description: Alias of registration_number (T + 13 digits). / registration_numberの別名（T＋13桁）。
t_number.title: T Number
